profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer  -  IFE System Network Specialist
profile.jobTitle: Staff Software Engineer - IFE System Configuration Technical Lead
profile.summary: Specialties: Large Software Project Integration Management,  IP Networking Protocols, IFE System Network Design, IFE Digital System Architecture, Network Management Software Architect and Developement (SNMP MIBs and Agent), LAMP System Architecture, WiFi 802.11n and 802.11b/g for WiFi Internet and AVOD streaming, OMTS system.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer - IFE System Configuration Technical Lead
positions.description:
o Staff Software Engineer (March 2018 - Present) - Thales InFlyt Network Specialist
    + Software Architect of IFE Configuration Web Application Tool Suites
    + Technical Lead for IFE system configurations (All aircraft types and Thales IFE Systems)
    + Designing and developing configuration validation software 
o Principal Network Software Engineer (Aug 2011 - March 2018)
    + Flight Test System Specialist for B777/B787 of Thales Top Connect i5000/i8000/AVANT.
    + System/Software Integration of Thales AVANT IFE System
    + Software/System Integration of TopConnect System: Onboard WiFi Internet and OMTS
    + Software/System Development an Integration of AVA (Wireless Content Distribution)
o i8000 on B787 System Software Integration Team Lead (Aug 2007 - Aug 2011)
o i5000 Network Configuration Software Lead (Jun 2006 - Aug 2007)
o i4000 System CBB Software Lead (WiFi Internet and Live TV Streaming) and SNMP agent development (May 2005 - Jun 2006)
o TopSeries SNMP MIB design and TopSeries BITE framework (Jan 2005 - May 2005)
